critical_code_review_comments: Acceptable mechanical fix: the new block at App.js:8646-8650 mirrors the existing tip_amount block (8641-8645) exactly, same classes (text-sm text-green-400 mt-1 font-medium), placed immediately after. No data-testid added — consistent with the sibling tip_amount block which also lacks one; suggest E1 add data-testid='onstage-tapped-tip' and 'onstage-dollar-tip' in a future polish pass to make this assertable without relying on the 💰 emoji string.

When both indicators show, they stack as two separate lines (each its own div, both mt-1). This is visually fine; if a single combined badge is desired (e.g., '💰 $10 tip + tapped'), that would be a design decision for E1, not a bug.

Pre-existing: dashboard On Stage tab and standalone /on-stage/:slug each have their own request-card rendering; the chart popup has a third. Consider extracting a shared RequestCard component to avoid drift between the three sites (the original bug was exactly such drift — tapped-tip was only present in 2/3 sites).
